name: STD-ENG-004
source: Engineering Project Document Topic System Standard (STD-ENG-004) Rev A, section 4. Draft: loading this catalogue does not approve the standard.

topics.title: Project Governance and Documentation Planning
topics.description: Scope, intended output, planning authority, lifecycle and deliverables; references to Proposal, ECP/SEMP, review and change records. Topic applicability and coverage expectations reside directly in Doctis.

topics.title: System Concept and Requirements
topics.description: Stakeholder needs, intended use, operational concept, boundaries, operating environment, requirements, constraints, acceptance criteria and traceability; typically PRD and concept material.

topics.title: Design and Descriptive Data
topics.description: Integrated system description, functional and physical architecture, interfaces, design rationale, trade-offs, allocations and configuration references; typically design description and ICD.

topics.title: Hardware and Physical Design
topics.description: Mechanical/electrical design, CAD, schematics, PCB data, BOM, tolerances, component choices, physical configuration and manufacturing design outputs. Applies where physical hardware is designed or integrated.

topics.title: Software, Firmware and AI Design
topics.description: Architecture, interfaces, dependencies, build configuration and implementation versions. For AI: dataset provenance and permitted use, partitioning, model/training configuration, evaluation baseline and known limitations. Applies where software, firmware or AI is developed or integrated.

topics.title: Safety, Risk and Compliance
topics.description: Project risk assessment, hazards, applicable obligations, controls, safety requirements, verification links and residual-risk decisions. Safety screening is required even when a detailed safety case is unnecessary.

topics.title: Verification and Validation
topics.description: Strategy, methods, traceability, procedures and acceptance criteria, equipment and test configuration, actual results, validation of intended use, failures, deviations and disposition; typically MTP, TP, VTM and Test Report.

topics.title: Production, Deployment, Operations and Maintenance
topics.description: Build and acceptance instructions where manufactured, installation and commissioning, operating limits, user/API documentation, calibration, servicing, diagnostics, updates and recovery appropriate to the intended use.

topics.title: In-Service Surveillance and Improvement
topics.description: Monitoring responsibilities, intervals, measures and intervention thresholds; inspections, reliability/field trends, AI drift where relevant, incident escalation and feedback into controlled engineering change.

topics.title: Retirement, Disposal and Archival
topics.description: Safe withdrawal, decommissioning, material disposal, data erasure, retention of design/IP/evidence, dependencies and responsibilities. A brief prototype closure instruction may suffice.
